Hello there! My name is Elizabeth Peterson. I prefer to go by Liz, but my family calls me Lizzie, or Lizzy, depending on who you ask. I generally introduce myself has Elizabeth, and then my preference slowly comes out over time. So I am working to introduce myself first as Liz. 

I graduated in June 2025 from UC Santa Barbara's Bren School of Environmnetal Science and Management with a Master of Environmental Data Science. In that program, I learned how to use data science (machine learning, geospatial analysis, statistics) to solve environmental problems, from the smallest species level ailments, to addressing climate change impacts on all sorts of communities (coastal, urban, low-income). Nowadays, I work in Impact Investing in San Francisco, working to direct private capital towards companies and funds working to solve environmental and social problems.

In work and in life, I am passionate about climate justice, biodiversity conservation, and climate policy. I am especially interested in the intersection of these. Most importantly, I am looking all the time to integrate my passion into my everyday life. If you are also thinking about these things, I would love to connect.

Take a look at my [About page](about.qmd) to learn more, or head over to the [Blog](posts.qmd) to see what I’ve been thinking about lately.
